name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS)
provider: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education
description: Central-sector scheme that supports meritorious students from economically weaker households to prevent dropout after Class 8. Selection is through the State-level Mental Ability Test and Scholastic Aptitude Test.
eligibility: Student in Class 9 or Class 10 (or Class 8 for the exam stage) of a recognised school; family income up to Rs. 3.50 lakh per annum; normally not availing another scholarship for the same stage.
income_limit: Family income up to Rs. 3.50 lakh per annum
benefits: Rs. 12,000 per year paid as maintenance allowance for Classes 9-10 and a lump amount on admission to Class 11.
deadline: Sample deadline: 31-11-2026 (verify on the official portal)
notes: Deadline shown is an illustrative sample value. Confirm the current notification on National Scholarship Portal before applying.

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship (CSSS / PM-USP)
provider: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
description: Central scholarship for meritorious students in recognised colleges and universities who scored above the 80th percentile in their Class 12 board examination.
eligibility: Regular student of a recognised college or university; above 80th percentile in the Class 12 board exam; family income up to Rs. 4.50 lakh per annum; not availing any other scholarship for the same course.
income_limit: Family income up to Rs. 4.50 lakh per annum
benefits: Rs. 12,000 per year for undergraduate students and Rs. 20,000 per year for postgraduate students, paid directly to the student through DBT.
deadline: Sample deadline: 31-10-2026 (verify on the official portal)
notes: Sample data. The exact percentile cut-off and deadline change each cycle - verify on the National Scholarship Portal.

name: PM-YASASVI Scholarship
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment and Ministry of Education
description: Central scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT students aimed at supporting school education and reducing dropout in Classes 9 to 12.
eligibility: Student of a government or recognised aided school in Classes 9 to 12; family income up to Rs. 2.50 lakh per annum; category OBC, EBC or DNT.
income_limit: Family income up to Rs. 2.50 lakh per annum
benefits: Up to Rs. 75,000 per year for Classes 9-10 and up to Rs. 1.25 lakh per year for Classes 11-12, covering tuition, books and uniform support.
deadline: Sample deadline: 31-08-2026 (verify on the official portal)
notes: Sample data. Benefit slabs and deadlines must be confirmed on the official portal.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education
description: Scholarship for girl students admitted to AICTE-approved technical diploma or degree programmes, to encourage higher technical education among women. Up to two girls from one family may apply.
eligibility: Girl student admitted in the first year of an AICTE-approved diploma or degree programme in engineering, technology, planning, architecture, hotel management or technology management; family income up to Rs. 8 lakh per annum.
income_limit: Family income up to Rs. 8 lakh per annum
benefits: Rs. 50,000 per year, paid annually for the duration of the programme.
deadline: Sample deadline: 31-10-2026 (verify on the official portal)
notes: Sample data. AICTE revises the approved course list and deadlines annually - verify on the AICTE student development schemes page.

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Specially-Abled Students
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education
description: Scholarship for differently-abled students admitted to AICTE-approved technical diploma or degree programmes, to support inclusive technical education.
eligibility: Differently-abled student admitted to an AICTE-approved diploma or degree programme in engineering, technology, planning, architecture, hotel management or technology management; disability of 40 percent or more as certified by a competent authority; family income up to Rs. 8 lakh per annum.
income_limit: Family income up to Rs. 8 lakh per annum
benefits: Rs. 50,000 per year, paid annually for the duration of the programme.
deadline: Sample deadline: 31-10-2026 (verify on the official portal)
notes: Sample data. Confirm the current disability-percentage requirement and deadline on the AICTE website.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
description: Central scheme that reimburses tuition and maintenance costs for Scheduled Caste students pursuing post-matriculation studies (Class 11 upwards, diploma, graduation and postgraduation). It is implemented through the concerned State or Union Territory governments.
eligibility: SC category student admitted to a recognised institution for post-matriculation study; family income up to Rs. 2.50 lakh per annum; not in receipt of another post-matric scholarship for the same course.
income_limit: Family income up to Rs. 2.50 lakh per annum
benefits: Full reimbursement of tuition fees plus a monthly maintenance allowance and an annual maintenance allowance for non-refundable items; rates vary by course and state.
deadline: Sample deadline: 31-10-2026 (verify on the state portal)
notes: Sample data. Benefits and income limits are notified separately by each state - always check the state social welfare portal.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Tribe Students
provider: Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India
description: Central scheme to support Scheduled Tribe students from Class 11 upwards by reimbursing tuition and maintenance costs, delivered through State and UT governments.
eligibility: ST category student admitted to a recognised institution for post-matriculation study; family income up to Rs. 2.50 lakh per annum.
income_limit: Family income up to Rs. 2.50 lakh per annum
benefits: Reimbursement of tuition fees plus monthly maintenance allowance and annual support for books and non-refundable items; rates vary by course and state.
deadline: Sample deadline: 31-10-2026 (verify on the state portal)

name: National Scholarship for Top Class Education for SC Students
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
description: Supports Scheduled Caste students admitted to notified top-class institutions such as central universities, national law universities, IITs, IIMs, NITs and medical colleges, including overseas education for a small number of seats.
eligibility: SC category student admitted to a notified top-class institution; family income up to Rs. 8 lakh per annum; not availing any other scholarship for the same course.
income_limit: Family income up to Rs. 8 lakh per annum
benefits: Full tuition and non-refundable fees paid directly to the institution plus a maintenance allowance of Rs. 10,000 per month; overseas scholarship also includes travel allowance and airfare for selected cases.
deadline: Sample deadline: 15-10-2026 (verify on the official portal)
notes: Sample data. The list of notified institutions changes every cycle - verify on the National Scholarship Portal.

name: UGC NET JRF Fellowship
description: Junior Research Fellowship for postgraduate students who clear the UGC NET examination, providing monthly support to carry out independent doctoral-level research.
eligibility: Postgraduate student (or final-year PG student) in a UGC-recognised university; admission rate of at least 55 percent for General, 50 percent for OBC and 45 percent for SC/ST/PwD candidates at PG level; age limit as notified for the current cycle.
income_limit: No income limit for the fellowship itself (admission requires 55 percent marks for General candidates)
benefits: Rs. 12,000 per month for three years for JRF awardees plus a Rs. 10,000 contingency grant per year, with a separate post-doctoral fellowship option.
deadline: Sample deadline: 30-09-2026 (verify on the UGC portal)
notes: Sample data. The current cycle age limit and admission cut-offs are notified by NTA and UGC each year - verify on ugcnet.nta.ac.in.

name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
provider: Department of Science and Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology
description: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education supports students pursuing undergraduate natural-science and basic-science courses such as B.Sc., B.S. and integrated M.Sc./M.S. programmes, to build a strong base in science.
eligibility: Student admitted to the first year of an eligible undergraduate or integrated masters science programme; generally requires senior secondary performance above the stated cut-off for the three years; no age ceiling is notified beyond the admission cycle.
income_limit: No family income limit is notified (merit based)
benefits: Rs. 80,000 per year for undergraduate science and integrated master students, with an additional research allowance for M.Sc. and M.S. students.
deadline: Sample deadline: 30-09-2026 (verify on the INSPIRE portal)
notes: Sample data. INSPIRE has discontinued some sub-schemes over time; confirm the live components on online-inspire.gov.in.

description: Fellowship for Other Backward Class candidates admitted to MPhil and PhD programmes in Indian universities and colleges, funded by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

income_limit: No income limit is notified (merit based)
benefits: Monthly fellowship as per UGC norms plus an annual contingency grant and a travel grant for eligible research programmes.
